title: rhythm-reset-and-decision-protocols-v0-1
body:
Purpose

This is a working draft to reset our company rhythm ahead of the next quarter, clarify a lightweight decision protocol for cross-functional tradeoffs, and align exec and all‑hands comms. Goal: by the end of the next two weeks we have a concise commitments list (owner + measure + rollback) that feeds the all‑hands and syncs to teams.

High-level outcomes we want
- Clear top 3 company priorities for the quarter with measurable guardrails (cost, latency, adoption).
- A simple decision protocol so product/infra/ops tradeoffs don’t stall (who decides, input required, fallback).
- A one‑page handout for the all‑hands and follow-up owner lists for each org.

Proposed cadence changes (pilot)
- Weekly 30m "Sprint Alignment" for exec + product leads (standing, 4 slots per quarter). Purpose: unblock decisions, surface regressions.
- Biweekly "Metrics & Signals" for SRE/product to present 3 signals (latency, cost per 1k tokens, model quality delta).
- Monthly asynchronous review doc for org heads: owners update section (3 lines) by Tuesday 9am before sync.

Decision protocol (lightweight)
1) Problem framing: short statement + metrics impacted (owner drafts).
2) Impact window: who will be impacted in 72hr / 30d / 90d horizons.
3) Decision owner: designate single owner (exec-level for cross-organization budget/SLAs; team lead for implementation tradeoffs).
4) Inputs: required metrics, one alternative, rollback condition.
5) Timeline: decision by X (date) or default fallback (safe-mode).

Draft top priorities (initial proposals)
- Priority A: Production inference stability — Reduce tail latency 95p by 20% and have an automatic fallback policy across regions. Owner: Marco Ruiz. Measure: 95p latency baseline -> target, rollout threshold.
- Priority B: Unit cost reduction — 12% effective per-token cost reduction through caching and batching recommendations on high-volume routes. Owner: Lena Zhang. Measure: $/k tokens.
- Priority C: Enterprise readiness — ship private deployment checklist and KMS integration for two reference customers. Owner: Priya Kapoor. Measure: checklist complete + customer signoff.

All‑hands artifact plan
- One slide: three priorities, owners, one metric each, one customer impact bullet.
- FAQ doc: anticipated questions and short answers for hosts.
- Post‑allhands follow-up: owners update doc with 30/60/90d checkpoints.

Open questions / risks
- Resource contention: Dedicated infra work vs stability improvements — need explicit allocation or temporary pause on low-impact experiments.
- Measurement gaps: some metrics are not instrumented for per-route cost attribution. Quick win: lightweight tagging on top 10 routes (SRE + product 2‑week task).
- Comms coordination: who scripts the all‑hands host notes? Proposal: Anjali + Owen prepare first draft; owners validate.

Next steps (two-week sprint)
- By EOD Thu: finalize top 3 priorities and owners (exec sync).
- Week 1: instrument route tags and baseline metrics (SRE + product).
- Week 2: draft all‑hands slide and FAQ; circulate to org leads for 48hr review.
- Decision: pick pilot cadence schedule and create calendar invites.

Notes to self / workboard
- Keep this doc minimal; move implementation details to per-owner trackers (Jira).
- Capture short blockers in shared Trello / Slack thread for quick triage.

Unresolved items
- Exact numbers for cost reduction target (12% is a placeholder; need finance validation).
- Fallback policy definition for model downgrade needs SRE input on capacity triggers.

If you’re reading this and assigned as an owner, please add a 2–3 line plan in the owner row and ping Anjali in #leadership-ops.

(Working draft — expect edits; this doc will be referenced during the exec alignment on 2025-02-05.)
